description:
Title: Instruct an artist to create a 3D model print it on a 3D printer

When craving a custom 3D model, as a first step you have to instruct an artist to create a project for you.
First you have to send him several sketches, and then tell him what to change until you are satisfied with the result.
After that, you choose a plastic color you want to use for 3D printing.
If you have the color at home (in stock), you check how much color you have left.
If it's under 100 grams, you put it on your shopping list.
If you do not have the color at home, you order it.
When you have the plastic, you can turn the printer on and heat up the bed and the extruder (it continuously sends you back its status).
While doing that, you can generate the gcode file for your printer out of the STL sent to you by the artist.
After that you print the model.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/artist-3d-print">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProjectInstructions" name="Project instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Sketches" name="Sketches"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ChangeRequest" name="Requested changes"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_STL" name="STL model"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_3DModel">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="You" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Artist" name="Artist" processRef="Process_Artist"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Printer" name="3D printer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Instructions" name="Project instructions" sourceRef="Task_InstructArtist" targetRef="Event_ArtistStart" messageRef="Message_ProjectInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Sketches" name="Sketches" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Task_ArtistReceiveSketches" messageRef="Message_Sketches"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ChangeRequest" name="Requested changes" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Event_ArtistRevisionStart" messageRef="Message_ChangeRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_InitialSTL" name="STL model" sourceRef="Task_SendInitialSTL" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RevisedSTL" name="Revised STL model" sourceRef="Task_SendRevisedSTL" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" messageRef="Message_STL"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrinterStatus" name="Printer status" sourceRef="Participant_Printer" targetRef="Event_PrinterStatusStart" messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Instruct an artist and print a 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_CustomerStart" name="Want a custom 3D model">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CustomerStart_Instruct</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_InstructArtist" name="Instruct the artist to create a project">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CustomerStart_Instruct</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Instruct_SendSketches</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSketches" name="Send sketches">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Instruct_SendSketches</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Sketches_ReceiveSTL</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveSTL" name="Receive the artist's STL model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Sketches_ReceiveSTL</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Changes_ReceiveSTL</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveSTL_Satisfaction</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Satisfied" name="Satisfied with the result?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveSTL_Satisfaction</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Satisfied_ChooseColor</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotSatisfied_SendChanges</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendChanges" name="Tell the artist what to change">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotSatisfied_SendChanges</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Changes_ReceiveSTL</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChooseColor" name="Choose a plastic color">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Satisfied_ChooseColor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChooseColor_InStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ColorInStock" name="Is the color at home?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChooseColor_InStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InStock_CheckAmount</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotInStock_Order</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckAmount" name="Check how much color is left">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InStock_CheckAmount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckAmount_Under100</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Under100" name="Under 100 grams?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckAmount_Under100</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Under100_ShoppingList</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AtLeast100_ColorReady</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddShoppingList" name="Put the color on the shopping list">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Under100_ShoppingList</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ShoppingList_ColorReady</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderPlastic" name="Order the plastic">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotInStock_Order</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Order_WaitPlastic</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PlasticAvailable" name="Plastic available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Order_WaitPlastic</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PlasticAvailable_ColorReady</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">plasticAvailable</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ColorReady" name="Continue with the plastic">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AtLeast100_ColorReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ShoppingList_ColorReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PlasticAvailable_ColorReady</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ColorReady_PreparationSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare printer and generate G-code">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ColorReady_PreparationSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToPrinterPreparation</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToGenerateGcode</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_PrinterPreparation" name="Turn on and heat the printer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToPrinterPreparation</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrinterPreparation_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_PrinterPreparationStart" name="Begin printer preparation">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PrinterStart_TurnOn</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_TurnOnPrinter" name="Turn on the printer">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrinterStart_TurnOn</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TurnOn_Heat</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_HeatBedAndExtruder" name="Heat the bed and the extruder">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TurnOn_Heat</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Heat_PrinterPreparationEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:task>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_PrinterPreparationEnd" name="Printer heated">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Heat_PrinterPreparationEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrinterStart_TurnOn" sourceRef="Event_PrinterPreparationStart" targetRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TurnOn_Heat" sourceRef="Task_TurnOnPrinter" targetRef="Task_HeatBedAndExtruder"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Heat_PrinterPreparationEnd" sourceRef="Task_HeatBedAndExtruder" targetRef="Event_PrinterPreparationEnd"/>
      <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_PrinterStatus" name="Receive ongoing printer status" triggeredByEvent="true">
        <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_PrinterStatusStart" name="Printer sends status" isInterrupting="false">
          <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StatusStart_StatusEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
          <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Message_PrinterStatus"/>
        </bpmn:startEvent>
        <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_PrinterStatusEnd" name="Status received">
          <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StatusStart_StatusEnd</bpmn:incoming>
        </bpmn:endEvent>
        <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StatusStart_StatusEnd" sourceRef="Event_PrinterStatusStart" targetRef="Event_PrinterStatusEnd"/>
      </bpmn:subProcess>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GenerateGcode" name="Generate G-code from the artist's STL">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToGenerateGcode</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Gcode_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Printer heated and G-code generated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PrinterPreparation_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Gcode_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_Print</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrintModel" name="Print the model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_Print</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Print_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_CustomerEnd" name="Model printed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Print_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerStart_Instruct" sourceRef="Event_CustomerStart" targetRef="Task_InstructArtist"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Instruct_SendSketches" sourceRef="Task_InstructArtist" targetRef="Task_SendSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Sketches_ReceiveSTL" sourceRef="Task_SendSketches" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveSTL_Satisfaction" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveSTL" targetRef="Gateway_Satisfied"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Satisfied_ChooseColor" name="Satisfied" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_ChooseColor">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">satisfiedWithResult</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotSatisfied_SendChanges" name="Changes needed" sourceRef="Gateway_Satisfied" targetRef="Task_SendChanges">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not satisfiedWithResult</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Changes_ReceiveSTL" sourceRef="Task_SendChanges" targetRef="Task_ReceiveSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChooseColor_InStock" sourceRef="Task_ChooseColor" targetRef="Gateway_ColorInStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock_CheckAmount" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorInStock" targetRef="Task_CheckAmount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">colorInStock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotInStock_Order" name="Not in stock" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorInStock" targetRef="Task_OrderPlastic">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not colorInStock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAmount_Under100" sourceRef="Task_CheckAmount" targetRef="Gateway_Under100"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Under100_ShoppingList" name="Under 100 grams" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Task_AddShoppingList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">colorAmountInGrams < 100</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AtLeast100_ColorReady" name="100 grams or more" sourceRef="Gateway_Under100" targetRef="Gateway_ColorReady">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">colorAmountInGrams >= 100</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShoppingList_ColorReady" sourceRef="Task_AddShoppingList" targetRef="Gateway_ColorReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_WaitPlastic" sourceRef="Task_OrderPlastic" targetRef="Event_PlasticAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlasticAvailable_ColorReady" sourceRef="Event_PlasticAvailable" targetRef="Gateway_ColorReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ColorReady_PreparationSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_ColorReady" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToPrinterPreparation" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="SubProcess_PrinterPreparation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToGenerateGcode" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_GenerateGcode"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrinterPreparation_Join" sourceRef="SubProcess_PrinterPreparation" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gcode_Join" sourceRef="Task_GenerateGcode" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Print" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_PrintModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Print_End" sourceRef="Task_PrintModel" targetRef="Event_CustomerEnd"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Artist" name="Create and revise the 3D model" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_ArtistStart" name="Receive project instructions">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ArtistStart_ReceiveSketches</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Message_ProjectInstructions"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ArtistReceiveSketches" name="Receive sketches">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ArtistStart_ReceiveSketches</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ArtistSketches_Create</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateProject" name="Create the project">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ArtistSketches_Create</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Create_SendInitialSTL</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInitialSTL" name="Send the STL model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Create_SendInitialSTL</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InitialSTL_ArtistEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_ArtistInitialEnd" name="Initial STL sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InitialSTL_ArtistEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Event_ArtistRevisionStart" name="Receive requested changes">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RevisionStart_Revise</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Message_ChangeRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviseProject" name="Revise the project">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RevisionStart_Revise</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Revise_SendSTL</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendRevisedSTL" name="Send the revised STL model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Revise_SendSTL</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RevisedSTL_ArtistEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="Event_ArtistRevisionEnd" name="Revised STL sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RevisedSTL_ArtistEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArtistStart_ReceiveSketches" sourceRef="Event_ArtistStart" targetRef="Task_ArtistReceiveSketches"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArtistSketches_Create" sourceRef="Task_ArtistReceiveSketches" targetRef="Task_CreateProject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Create_SendInitialSTL" sourceRef="Task_CreateProject" targetRef="Task_SendInitialSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InitialSTL_ArtistEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendInitialSTL" targetRef="Event_ArtistInitialEnd"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RevisionStart_Revise" sourceRef="Event_ArtistRevisionStart" targetRef="Task_ReviseProject"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Revise_SendSTL" sourceRef="Task_ReviseProject" targetRef="Task_SendRevisedSTL"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RevisedSTL_ArtistEnd" sourceRef="Task_SendRevisedSTL" targetRef="Event_ArtistRevisionEnd"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
